en.askTitle: Put in your own passport, city and dates to get a Schengen application plan with deadlines worked back from your departure
en.runTitle: Bengaluru to France and Italy: a first Schengen visa for a couple, departing 15 May 2027

fields.label: Nationality and passport
fields.value: Indian couple, both salaried; neither has held a Schengen visa before

fields.label: Countries, day split and first external border
fields.value: France and Italy, with the split of days not yet decided

en.template: Help me plan a Schengen tourism application for {nationality}, living in {city}, travelling {dates} through {route}. Identify the competent country, separate the application clocks, list official document and fee checks, and suggest an early target with contingencies. Do not create accounts, book, apply or pay.

phases.title: Check the official France and Italy application, document and fee pages
phases.note: Where to apply from Bengaluru, which documents, which fees
phases.judgment: It corrected a common assumption with the official checklist: France asks for three months of bank statements and one previous year’s income-tax return, not six months and three years. And where the visa centre’s page published no rupee figure for its service fee, it did not make one up by converting.

phases.title: Write the guide, a dated timeline and the source list
phases.judgment: Because the split of days between France and Italy was not given, it did not pick a country for the couple. The guide covers both routes and names what is still unconfirmed: Italy’s visa-centre street address and France’s service charge in rupees.

phases.title: Final check of the content and links, and one page-layout check

workers: Went through France’s official visa checklist and published fees for a salaried couple applying from Bengaluru
Checked which Italian consulate and visa centre handle Bengaluru, and what could and could not be confirmed about Italian fees and documents

zh.askTitle: 填上你自己的护照、城市和日期，得到一份从出发日往回倒推截止时间的申根申请计划
zh.runTitle: 班加罗尔到法国和意大利：一对夫妻首次申根签证，2027 年 5 月 15 日出发

fields.label: 国籍和护照
fields.value: 印度籍夫妻，两人都有固定工作；之前都没有申根签证

fields.label: 旅行日期（抵达和离境）
fields.value: 2027 年 5 月 15 日出发，行程 10 天

fields.label: 国家、各国天数和首个外部边境
fields.value: 法国和意大利，各国停留天数尚未定

zh.template: 请帮我规划申根旅游申请：国籍和护照{nationality}，居住{city}，旅行日期{dates}，行程{route}。先判断受理国家，分开递交、等预约、审理和护照返还时间，列出官方材料与费用核对项，给提前目标及应急方案。不要创建账户、预约、递交或付款。

phases.title: 核对法国和意大利的官方申请、材料和费用页面
phases.note: 在班加罗尔去哪里递交、要哪些材料、收哪些费用
phases.judgment: 它用官方清单纠正了一个常见说法：法国要的是最近三个月的银行流水和上一个财年的一份所得税申报，不是六个月流水和三年申报。签证中心页面没有公布服务费的卢比金额时，它也没有自己换算一个数。

phases.title: 写指南、带日期的时间线和来源清单
phases.judgment: 由于没有给出法国和意大利各待几天，它没有替这对夫妻选定受理国。指南把两条路线都写了，并列出仍未确认的两项：意大利签证中心的街道地址，以及法国服务费的卢比金额。

phases.title: 最后检查内容和链接，并检查一次页面版式

workers: 逐项核对法国官方的签证材料清单和公布的费用，按在班加罗尔申请的在职夫妻来看
核对班加罗尔归哪个意大利领事馆和签证中心受理，以及意大利的费用和材料哪些能确认、哪些不能
